alive.last_commit_message:
feat(agent-scan): forward prompt and selected skills to the scanner (#704)

The agent_scan task API previously accepted a prompt field that was never forwarded to main.py, and offered no way to select detection skills. This forwards prompt via -p/--prompt and adds an optional skills array validated against the AgentScanSkills whitelist (11 entries, matching the Python _DETECTION_SKILLS registry incl. memory-rag-poisoning-detection), then passed as --skills=a,b. Unknown skill names are rejected by websocket/api.go. api.md/zh/ja + swagger docs updated. Verified 2026-10-14 and re-checked today: go build/vet clean, common/agent + websocket tests pass (incl. new argv construction and validation cases), CI green after unblocking the fork-PR workflow approval. Towards #435 (skill-level selection).
